name: local-skills
description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: build-fast
plugins.description: Manual-only prototype build, invoked with /build-fast. Gets a working first-draft script into the user's hands as fast as possible — the one or two things asked, output that satisfies the need, refine later.

plugins.name: bump-homebrew
plugins.description: Automate releasing a new Homebrew formula version — tags the repo, builds a deterministic tarball, uploads a GitHub Release asset, and updates the formula.

plugins.name: chart-viz
plugins.description: Manual-only chart decision framework, invoked with /chart-viz. Resolves chart type, color, decluttering, emphasis, and sorting against the question, data shape, medium, and audience rather than applying a fixed checklist.

plugins.name: clawd
plugins.description: Mod: Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, stands on the prompt's top border in the terminal. It types away on a laptop while Claude works, and while idle plays a random little animation every few seconds (blink, wave, jump, dance, shuffle and more). /clawd shows or hides him.

plugins.name: code-animation
plugins.description: Manual-only code animation, invoked with /code-animation. Turns your source materials (brand, character sheet, storyboard, music) into a scene written in code, renders it frame-exact in headless Chromium, and exports MP4, GIF, WebM or ProRes with alpha.

plugins.name: code-wallpaper
plugins.description: Manual-only code-drawn wallpaper render, invoked with /code-wallpaper. Paints a landscape entirely in code, as oil on linen or as layered paper cut, and exports a PNG at any resolution — 4K, ultrawide, or phone.

plugins.name: critic-loop
plugins.description: Manual-only reference-free critic loop, invoked with /critic-loop. One builder works from the project's existing code, design files and docs (or from the request alone in an empty project) and revises against fresh-context critics until no critic has a blocking issue and every scored critic clears a configurable floor, the round cap is hit, or the builder changes nothing.

plugins.name: dashboard-design
plugins.description: Apply expert dashboard design principles when building, auditing, or critiquing dashboards and data tables — enforces data-driven form, progressive disclosure, and invisible UI.

plugins.name: design-loop
plugins.description: Manual-only design critic loop, invoked with /design-loop. Takes a goal and a real-world reference, tears the reference down into checkable mechanisms, then runs a builder and three fresh-context critics (brief, system, craft) on every piece until all three agree ours wins.

plugins.name: extract-dna
plugins.description: Manual-only design DNA extraction, invoked with /extract-dna. Measures one design system — screenshot, URL, PDF, video/GIF, code/CSS, or design file, one sample or several of the same system — into a dna.json record and a dna.md guide, proven complete by rebuilding the reference and diffing it numerically.

plugins.name: fresh-start
plugins.description: Manual-only clean-slate pass, invoked with /fresh-start. Treats existing code as a spec, not a foundation — extracts the behavior it must keep, writes an independent implementation, compares both, and keeps whichever is simpler and correct.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: Manual-only project kickoff, invoked with /kickoff. Turns a vague idea into a short BRIEF.md, asking only about the gaps that would change the build.

plugins.name: limits
plugins.description: Mod: your 5-hour and weekly usage limits, reset countdowns and context fill in a band above the prompt, in the Claude desktop app only (the terminal shows nothing). App-only copy of Ryan-LT/claude-mods limits.

plugins.name: live-tasks
plugins.description: Mod: a live task list above the prompt in the Claude Code CLI (off in the desktop app), like the desktop app's pinned plan. Claude sends the plan with its first tool call and checks steps off as it works; /live-tasks shows, hides or clears it.

plugins.name: mobile-screen-design
plugins.description: Manual-only mobile screen design pass, invoked with /mobile-screen-design. Reviews or builds any mobile app screen in two passes: a defect pass (overlay contrast, media style-consistency, icon axes, mutable state in copy, decision order, action grouping, label/accessibility splits) then a flow pass (scroll context, sticky actions, common-case presets). Rules are graded by evidence strength against Apple HIG, Material, WCAG, and NN/g.

plugins.name: pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Convert a PDF, a page range, or one section of it to markdown that keeps the merged-cell tables intact, then verify against the source that no text was lost.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: Manual-only, invoked with /plain-writing. Plain, boring prose style, plus /plain-writing deslopify. Vendored from docwriter-org/plain-writing-skill (MIT).

plugins.name: plan-interview
plugins.description: Walk through a space of interconnected decisions via structured interview — useful when the path forward is unclear and you need to resolve trade-offs before acting.

plugins.name: plan-relax
plugins.description: Run a relaxed, low-pressure decision interview to think through interconnected choices with trade-offs.

plugins.name: reply-quote
plugins.description: Mod: /reply lists the paragraphs of Claude's last reply, your mouse selection and your clipboard, and quotes the one you pick into the prompt. In fullscreen, also a hover ↩ on each paragraph and a "Reply to selection" button under selected text.

plugins.name: to-prd
plugins.description: Turn the current conversation context into a PRD grounded in existing decision logs, without re-interviewing the user.

plugins.name: translate-to-thai
plugins.description: Translate text into natural Thai, keeping technical terms, product names, and specific keywords in English where that reads more naturally to a Thai speaker.

plugins.name: tufte-clarity
plugins.description: Apply Tufte's information design principles to UI layouts, web pages, and presentation slides — reduces chrome, improves signal density.

plugins.name: tufte-viz
plugins.description: Ideate and critique data visualizations using Tufte's principles: data-ink ratio, chartjunk elimination, graphical integrity, and small multiples.

plugins.name: wallpaper-upscale
plugins.description: Manual-only local wallpaper upscale, invoked with /wallpaper-upscale. Turns an image, YouTube thumbnail or video frame into a high-res Mac wallpaper: best source, AI upscale (IllustrationJaNai for art, RealPLKSR for photos), optional logo removal, crop to screen.

plugins.name: why-chain
plugins.description: Manual-only root-cause dig, invoked with /why-chain. Asks why until it reaches the cause behind what we are about to do, rebuilds the fix from that root, and tests the root cause as a hypothesis before anything is built.

plugins.name: worktree-swarm
plugins.description: Split a multi-part fix/feature into worktree-isolated subagents run in parallel, then manually integrate and verify the results.
